course.title: Unit 7 What’s the highest mountain in the world?【例句】

sentences.content: Do you have any questions about baby pandas?
sentences.english: Do you have any questions about baby pandas ?
sentences.chinese: 关于小熊猫，您有什么疑问吗？

sentences.content: Are they much smaller than an adult panda?
sentences.english: Are they much smaller than an adult panda ?
sentences.chinese: 它们比成年熊猫小很多吗？

sentences.content: Yes. When they’re born, they only weigh about 0.1 to 0.2 kilos.
sentences.english: Yes . When they're born , they only weigh about 0.1 to 0.2 kilos
sentences.chinese: 是的。它们刚出生时，体重仅有0.1至0.2公斤。

wordDetails.definition: 出生（过去分词）: 出生

sentences.content: Wow, that’s small! I know an adult panda weighs many times more than a baby.
sentences.english: Wow , that's small ! I know an adult panda weighs many times more than a baby
sentences.chinese: 哇，这也太小了吧！我知道成年熊猫的体重是幼崽的好几倍。

wordDetails.definition: weigh（第三人称单数）: 称重

sentences.content: That’s right. And the adult pandas weigh around 100 kilos.
sentences.english: That's right . And the adult pandas weigh around 100 kilos
sentences.chinese: 没错。成年大熊猫的体重约为100公斤。

sentences.content: What about the size of a baby panda? How small is it?
sentences.english: What about the size of a baby panda ? How small is it ?
sentences.chinese: 小熊猫的体型有多大？它有多小呢？

sentences.content: At birth, it’s only around 15 cm long, but an adult panda is around 150 cm long.
sentences.english: At birth , it's only around 15 cm long , but an adult panda is around 150 cm long
sentences.chinese: 刚出生时，它只有约15厘米长，但成年大熊猫的体长可达150厘米左右。

sentences.content: Is a baby panda also black and white?
sentences.english: Is a baby panda also black and white ?
sentences.chinese: 熊猫宝宝也是黑白色的吗？

sentences.content: No, you would never guess! A baby panda is pink and it cannot see.
sentences.english: No , you would never guess ! A baby panda is pink and it cannot see
sentences.chinese: 不，你绝对猜不到！小熊猫刚出生时是粉红色的，而且看不见东西。

sentences.content: It also doesn’t have any teeth.
sentences.english: It also doesn't have any teeth
sentences.chinese: 它也没有任何牙齿。

sentences.content: How long can pandas live?
sentences.english: How long can pandas live ?
sentences.chinese: 熊猫能活多久？

sentences.content: They can live up to 20 to 30 years.
sentences.english: They can live up to 20 to 30 years
sentences.chinese: 它们的寿命可达20至30年。

sentences.content: It is 8:30 a.m. at the Chengdu Research Base. Panda keepers are preparing milk for the baby pandas’ breakfast.
sentences.english: It is 8:30 a . m . at the Chengdu Research Base . Panda keepers are preparing milk for the baby pandas' breakfast
sentences.chinese: 现在是上午8:30，在成都研究基地。熊猫饲养员正在为熊猫宝宝们的早餐准备牛奶。

sentences.content: At 9:00 a.m., they find that most of the babies are already awake and hungry.
sentences.english: At 9:00 a . m ., they find that most of the babies are already awake and hungry
sentences.chinese: 上午9点时，他们发现大多数婴儿已经醒来并且饿了。

sentences.content: When the babies see the keepers, they run over to them with excitement and some of the young pandas even walk into their friends and fall over!
sentences.english: When the babies see the keepers , they run over to them with excitement and some of the young pandas even walk into their friends and fall over !
sentences.chinese: 当熊猫宝宝们看到饲养员时，会兴奋地跑向他们，有些幼崽甚至不小心撞到同伴身上摔个跟头！

sentences.content: Lin Wei, one of the panda keepers, says, “They’re so cute and lovely. I take care of them like they’re my own babies. I wash, feed and play with them every day. They’re very special to me.”
sentences.english: Lin Wei , one of the panda keepers , says ," They're so cute and lovely . I take care of them like they're my own babies . I wash , feed and play with them every day . They're very special to me ."
sentences.chinese: 熊猫饲养员Lin Wei表示：“它们太可爱了。我像照顾自己的孩子一样照料它们，每天给它们洗澡、喂食、陪玩耍。对我来说它们非常特别。”

sentences.content: In fact, many people around the world love these black and white animals.
sentences.english: In fact , many people around the world love these black and white animals
sentences.chinese: 事实上，世界各地很多人都喜爱这些黑白相间的动物。

sentences.content: Pandas have become so popular that they are now a symbol of China.
sentences.english: Pandas have become so popular that they are now a symbol of China
sentences.chinese: 熊猫如今已成为中国的象征，其受欢迎程度可见一斑。

sentences.content: Scientists say there are now fewer than 2,000 pandas living in the forests.
sentences.english: Scientists say there are now fewer than 2 ,000 pandas living in the forests
sentences.chinese: 科学家表示，目前生活在森林中的大熊猫不足2000只。

sentences.content: Another 700 or so live in zoos or research centers in China and other countries.
sentences.english: Another 700 or so live in zoos or research centers in China and other countries
sentences.chinese: 另有约700只生活在China及其他国家的动物园或研究中心。

sentences.content: Pandas do not have many babies, maybe only one every two years.
sentences.english: Pandas do not have many babies , maybe only one every two years
sentences.chinese: 熊猫的繁殖率不高，可能每两年才产下一只幼崽。

sentences.content: The babies often die from illnesses and do not live very long.
sentences.english: The babies often die from illnesses and do not live very long
sentences.chinese: 这些婴儿常常死于疾病，寿命都不长。

sentences.content: Adult pandas spend more than 12 hours a day eating about 10 kilos of bamboo.
sentences.english: Adult pandas spend more than 12 hours a day eating about 10 kilos of bamboo
sentences.chinese: 成年大熊猫每天要花12个多小时进食，吃掉约10公斤竹子。

sentences.content: Many years ago, there were a lot more bamboo forests and pandas in China, but then humans started to cut down these forests.
sentences.english: Many years ago , there were a lot more bamboo forests and pandas in China , but then humans started to cut down these forests
sentences.chinese: 许多年前，中国的竹林和大熊猫数量远比现在多，但后来人类开始砍伐这些森林。

wordDetails.definition: cut（短语动词原型）: 砍伐

sentences.content: As the forests get smaller and other human activities cause more problems, pandas cannot find enough to eat and they are having fewer babies.
sentences.english: As the forests get smaller and other human activities cause more problems , pandas cannot find enough to eat and they are having fewer babies
sentences.chinese: 随着森林面积不断缩小，加之其他人类活动导致的问题日益增多，熊猫难以找到充足的食物来源，其繁殖数量也随之减少。

sentences.content: An education program in Chengdu teaches children about pandas and other endangered wild animals.
sentences.english: An education program in Chengdu teaches children about pandas and other endangered wild animals
sentences.chinese: 成都的一个教育项目向孩子们传授有关熊猫及其他濒危野生动物的知识。

wordDetails.definition: teach（第三人称单数现在时）: 教授

sentences.content: They send people to schools to tell children about the importance of saving these animals.
sentences.english: They send people to schools to tell children about the importance of saving these animals
sentences.chinese: 他们派人到学校向孩子们宣讲保护这些动物的重要性。

sentences.content: And the Chinese government is trying hard to help save the pandas.
sentences.english: And the Chinese government is trying hard to help save the pandas
sentences.chinese: 中国政府正在努力帮助拯救大熊猫。

sentences.content: Scientists are doing research to better understand the habits of pandas.
sentences.english: Scientists are doing research to better understand the habits of pandas
sentences.chinese: 科学家们正在进行研究，以更好地了解熊猫的习性。

sentences.content: We all hope that in the future there will be a lot more pandas.
sentences.english: We all hope that in the future there will be a lot more pandas
sentences.chinese: 我们都希望未来会有更多的大熊猫。
